name: white-background
title: 白底正面图
prompt: Create a photorealistic ecommerce primary product photograph, square frame. Show exactly one finished rectangular flannel throw blanket, {width} inches wide by {height} inches tall, fully unfolded and seen directly from the front. Center it upright, perfectly readable complete front print, occupying about 90 percent of image height. Pure white RGB 255,255,255 background all the way to the corners. The blanket has soft short-pile flannel, a subtle matching hem, gently soft edges but no folded corners, no dramatic waves or hanging hardware. Preserve the referenced artwork faithfully across the complete front from edge to edge. No text, arrows, logos, extra objects, props, people, packaging, collage or inset. Professional even lighting with detailed fabric, no dark drop shadow.

name: size-guide
title: 尺寸图
prompt: Use the approved white-background product photo without redrawing its artwork. Center the blanket itself horizontally and vertically on a clean white square canvas, with equal left and right margins around the blanket; do not shift it left to accommodate a label. Reserve sufficient space outside the centered blanket for width and height arrows. Label only {width} in and {height} in, using inches exclusively for the US market, with no metric conversion. Dimensions describe the selected SKU only. Render lettering and arrows deterministically in postprocessing. The title is BLANKET SIZE. Keep all labels and arrowheads within the canvas and clear of the product.

name: sofa-scene
title: 沙发场景
prompt: Create a photorealistic square lifestyle photograph in a welcoming American living room with a light gray three-seat sofa and restrained decor appropriate to the artwork. Show the referenced {width} by {height} inch flannel blanket with its width running across the sofa and length following the back-seat-front surface. {sofa_scale} Keep both sofa arms and enough uncovered seating visible to judge scale, using a moderate straight-on or gentle three-quarter camera angle. Keep the recognizable design naturally draped; folds consume fabric length and must not create extra cloth. Never enlarge the throw to cover the entire sofa, shrink the furniture to fit it, or use misleading wide-angle perspective. Soft daylight, short-pile fabric. No dimension labels, text, inset, logo or watermark.

name: bedroom-scene
title: 卧室场景
prompt: Create a photorealistic square bedroom product photograph. Place the same {width} by {height} inch flannel blanket lengthwise on the foot portion of a queen mattress, with its width across the mattress and its length along the mattress. {bed_scale} Show the entire mattress outline and adjacent white bedding clearly enough to assess coverage, from a moderate elevated three-quarter angle without strong perspective distortion. Keep natural shallow fabric folds and the original print. No oversized side or floor drape that would require more cloth than the stated dimensions. Do not depict a fitted sheet or convert a throw into a duvet. Bright soft daylight and restrained decor. No person, words, logo, inset or watermark.

name: person-using
title: 人物使用场景
prompt: Create a photorealistic square lifestyle product photograph of one fully clothed adult woman, approximately 30 years old, reading an unbranded book while seated on a light neutral sofa. The same {width} by {height} inch flannel blanket covers her lap and legs. {person_scale} Keep her head, torso, seat and foot area in frame so body scale is assessable. Show realistic hands, knees and naturally gathered cloth with no hidden extra-length train, no floor-filling blanket and no enlarged print surface. Preserve recognizable motif placement. Soft daylight, comfortable home, moderate camera distance. No words, logos, insets or watermark.

name: fabric-detail
title: 正面面料细节
prompt: Create a photorealistic square textile macro photograph of the FRONT PRINTED SURFACE of the same lightweight flannel blanket. Make actual material characteristics the focus rather than enlarging the illustration: a shallow supple fold runs diagonally through the frame, a neatly stitched narrow hem occupies one edge, and a sharply focused patch of fine dense very short velvety nap occupies roughly one third of the image. Use soft raking side light to reveal the short fibers and the fabric's smooth flexible surface without making it look thick or rough. Select a recognizable cropped portion of the supplied design, including a quiet pale printed area where fibers can be seen; preserve the dye colors and print edges. Show coherent focus across nap and hem with gentle falloff elsewhere. No rolled-up tube, exposed underside or invented backing. No chunky fleece, shag, boucle, sherpa, terry, fur, wool, embroidery, raised ink or quilting. Do not add unsupported thickness, GSM or fiber-composition claims. One photographic view, no text, collage, magnification inset, props or watermark.

name: machine-wash
title: 机洗展示
prompt: Create a photorealistic square lifestyle photograph showing one fully clothed adult woman actively loading the same {width} by {height} inch flannel blanket into an open front-loading washing machine. {wash_scale} She bends or crouches naturally, one hand supporting the gathered blanket outside and the other guiding a leading portion into the drum. Show distinct hands and the loading action; the blanket is partly inside and partly supported outside, not simply abandoned dangling from the machine. The doorway, torso and arms must remain visible as size references. Preserve recognizable portions of the print without squeezing the entire artwork onto the small visible folded section. No giant blanket pile, cloth passing through a closed door, floating hands, extra limbs or physically impossible load. No detergent brand, temperature, wash-cycle count, before-and-after comparison, certification or tested-fade-resistance claim. No text or watermark.

name: gift-presentation
title: 礼品展示
prompt: Create a photorealistic square gift-presentation photograph containing BOTH a visible gift ribbon tied into a neat bow and a proportionate gift box with its lid open or resting beside it. Place the same blanket neatly folded in the box so the ribbon, box construction and a recognizable cropped part of the print are visible. Match the box to the believable folded blanket volume, not the unfolded dimensions. Do not shrink and repeat the entire artwork onto the folded top surface. {packaging_instruction} Warm restrained seasonal styling, crisp textile detail, coordinated simple colors, no brand logos or readable greeting-card text. Distinguish styling props from confirmed included packaging. No certification or care claims. Leave a slim clear bottom area for a truthful styling caption when required.
